selection_rule: Best 5-fold CV F1 (spam class) on the training split; families within 0.005 of the best are tie-broken in favour of Naive Bayes (simpler).

selection_outcome.text: Logistic Regression had the best CV F1 (0.9842). Multinomial Naive Bayes scored 0.9771, 0.0071 lower: more than the 0.005 tolerance, so the tie-break in favour of Multinomial Naive Bayes was not triggered and Logistic Regression was selected.
